photo_observations.observations: Feather-like leaves radiate at separated whorls around pale reddish stems. Each leaf has a central rachis and many paired fine segments; different from hornwort's few repeated forks. Wet specimen droops outside water.

photo_observations.voxel_implications: Fine pinnules are subvoxel. Model a bounded underwater shoot segment/patch and coarse whorl spacing; avoid scaling feather leaves to giant fern fronds.
